title: Cause and Result with -va/-ve: *okozva*, *teremtve*, *szülve*
goal: I can add a result to a sentence with a *-va/-ve* participle (*bérletörést okozva*, *létbizonytalanságot teremtve*).
I can name how pay is pushed down and work is passed on (*bérletörés*, *alvállalkozói lánc*, *létbizonytalanság*).
I can write a sentence that links a company's decision to its effect on workers.
